$comment: Accepted production-dependency advisories for scripts/audit-gate.mjs. Every entry needs a reason and an expiry; an expired entry fails CI so the risk is re-argued, not forgotten.

advisories.reason: Reachable only while the Prisma CLI loads prisma.config.ts at migrate time; no request path merges attacker-controlled objects. Fixed upstream in Prisma 8.1; the upgrade is scheduled with the surrogate-key work in P1-00.
imagekit 6 pins an old uuid; the vulnerable v3/v5/v6 buffer path is not used. imagekit is replaced by @imagekit/nodejs when attachments move to the storage abstraction (P1-03).
